Herewith some information about the church

Welcome to Transformation City Church (TCC), a community where your journey with God and your relationships with others are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that ordinary people can live extraordinary lives when they choose to follow Jesus daily.
Our Vision and Goals
As a church, our vision is simple yet profound: to be God’s transformation agent in our city. We are committed to a journey of growth, focusing on three primary goals:
• Knowing God more deeply every day.
• Loving People with a sincere and heartfelt devotion.
• Transforming Our World by sharing the hope and power we have received.
The Impact Life
At TCC, we often speak about living an "Impact Life." This is a life intentionally designed to serve others and is defined by a deep, daily awareness of our dependence on God. We believe that the transformation process is twofold: first, realizing our need for God, and second, allowing Him to use us in the lives of others.
Our community is built on the foundation of fellowship with believers. We follow the "new command" given by Jesus to love one another just as He has loved us. For us, fellowship is more than just a social association; it is a discipline of truly loving and supporting our fellow believers, recognizing that we are all part of one Body. Through this love, the world will know we are His disciples.
A Culture of Service and Testimony
We believe that love is a verb. We are called to serve one another humbly in love, putting aside our own preferences for the sake of the community. We also believe in the power of your personal story. Each person has a unique testimony of how God has saved and transformed them, and we are empowered by the Holy Spirit to be witnesses of His grace. By bearing "fruit"—characteristics like love, joy, peace, and kindness—we ensure that our actions speak even louder than our words.
Your Next Step
Whether you are just starting to explore faith or are looking for a place to call home, we invite you to take your next step with us:
1. Join Our Family: Find a place where you truly belong.
2. Experience the Impact Life Journey: Embark on a path of spiritual maturity and discovery.
3. Be Part of a Connect Group: Engage in supportive, life-changing relationships.
4. Live a Transformation Life: Step out in faith to be a blessing to those around you.
We invite you to follow the example of Christ, aligning your thoughts and feelings with His. Humble yourself before the Lord, and He will lift you up as you seek to serve Him in our city.
You can do all things through Him who gives you strength. Welcome home to Transformation City Church.
